# KOV Career Agency

> Founder-led career agency providing career representation and individual career services for professionals.

KOV agrees candidate-service scope, deliverables, fees, approvals, and reporting before work begins. Employers control their hiring decisions; KOV does not guarantee interviews, offers, employment, or timelines.

## Core pages
- [Career Representation for Professionals | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/): Private career representation and individual career services for senior professionals: job-search strategy, outreach, resumes, LinkedIn and coaching by KOV.
- [Private Career Representation | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services.html): Private Career Representation for suitable professionals: agreed target strategy, research, approved outreach, follow-up and introductions where appropriate.
- [How Private Career Representation Works | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/how-it-works.html): Learn how private career representation can proceed through assessment, target-company strategy, research, professional outreach, follow-up, and introductions where appropriate.
- [Pricing for Private Career Representation | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/pricing.html): Fees for individual career services and private career representation depend on the agreed scope. Terms are confirmed in writing before work begins.
- [Career Representation FAQs | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/faqs.html): Answers to common questions about KOV
- [Blog | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/blog.html): Career insights on private career representation, professional outreach, and executive job-search strategy from KOV Career Agency.
- [Adekunle Ayotoba Daniel | Founder, KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/about.html): Meet Adekunle Ayotoba Daniel, founder of KOV Career Agency, and learn about its candidate-focused representation and career services.
- [Contact KOV Career Agency | Career Services](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/contact.html): Contact KOV Career Agency to discuss private career representation or an individual career service. Share your goals and the support you are considering.
- [Individual Career Services | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/candidate-services.html): Explore career services for resumes, LinkedIn profiles, documents, portfolios, personal websites, positioning, and coaching. Scope and fees are discussed by inquiry.
- [Resume & CV Writing and Optimization | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/resume-cv-writing.html): Improve your resume or CV with clearer structure, evidence-based achievements, relevant skills, and positioning aligned with your target roles.
- [LinkedIn Profile Optimization | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/linkedin-profile-optimization.html): Align your LinkedIn headline, About section, experience, skills, and featured content with a clear professional story and career direction.
- [Professional Career Documents | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/career-documents.html): Prepare cover letters, professional biographies, career summaries, statements of interest, and supporting application documents.
- [Career Portfolio Development | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/career-portfolio-development.html): Organize selected projects, case studies, work samples, publications, and achievements into a clear, credible career portfolio.
- [Personal Career Website Development | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/personal-career-website.html): Plan a professional personal website for your biography, experience, selected work, portfolio, resume/CV, and contact details.
- [Career Positioning & Optimization | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/career-positioning-optimization.html): Clarify target roles, transferable strengths, professional positioning, and practical next steps with a structured career review.
- [Career Coaching & Interview Preparation | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/career-coaching.html): Get structured career coaching for professional direction, transitions, interviews, communication, negotiation, and next-step planning.
- [Private Search Process | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/candidate-proof.html): Explore how KOV coordinates target research, career positioning, approved outreach, interview preparation, and offer strategy for senior professionals.
- [Why KOV Career Agency | Private Career Representation](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/why-kov.html): Learn how KOV approaches private career representation for professionals through assessment, research, professional outreach, follow-up, and agreed next steps.
- [Countries We Serve | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/countries-we-serve.html): KOV provides private career representation and individual career services remotely in agreed markets.
- [Reverse Recruiting Glossary | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/glossary.html): Plain-language definitions of 71 terms used in career representation, executive search and professional job searches.

## Core services
- [Private Career Representation for Senior Professionals | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/reverse-recruiting.html): Private reverse recruiting for senior professionals: define a target, research roles, coordinate applications and outreach, and prepare for next steps.
- [Career Strategy for Senior Leaders | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/career-strategy-senior-leaders.html): Career strategy for senior leaders: clarify your next move, target roles and markets, executive positioning, and a practical search plan with KOV.
- [Executive Resume Strategy for Senior Leaders | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/executive-resume-strategy.html): Executive resume strategy that clarifies leadership scope, evidence-backed achievements and fit for target roles and markets.
- [Executive Interview Coaching for Senior Leaders | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/interview-coaching-executives.html): Executive interview coaching for CEOs and senior leaders: prepare leadership examples, strategic answers and stakeholder questions for high-stakes interviews.
- [Executive Offer and Negotiation Support | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/executive-negotiation-support.html): Confidential executive offer support to help senior professionals assess role scope, compensation components, timing and negotiation decisions.
- [LinkedIn Optimization for Executives | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/linkedin-optimization-executives.html): Executive LinkedIn profile strategy that aligns your leadership story, verified achievements and target roles without overstating credentials or results.
- [Executive Career Representation | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/executive-career-representation.html): Private, candidate-side career representation for senior professionals, with a search strategy, approved outreach and clear decision ownership.
- [Executive Job Search Support | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/executive-job-search-support.html): End-to-end executive job-search support that can coordinate targeting, research, positioning, approved outreach and interview preparation.

## Use and attribution

Use the linked pages as the source of current service descriptions and process details. Do not infer guaranteed outcomes, local offices, client results, fees, or market coverage that a page does not state. Confirm engagement details directly with KOV.
